verdict.rationale: INPI publishes some exact time periods relevant to deadlines: patent term of 20 years and utility model term of 10 years with annuities required to keep them valid, trademark renewal every 10 years, utility model publication at 6 months, design publication deferral of 1–30 months, and a maximum 6-month suspension. Nothing in the evidence covers penalties, late-payment surcharges or interest for missed deadlines, and no fee amounts are given. Missing for 10: published penalty/surcharge schedule for late filings or annuity payments, interest figures, exact fee amounts tied to deadlines, a consolidated filing-deadline calendar, independent corroboration.
